title: Capt. Matthew Beverage of Hope and Nathaniel Beverage of Rockland — published 1865 family groups
kind: Source-attributed historical reconstruction; not a modern official civil register

publication.title: History of Thomaston, Rockland, and South Thomaston, volume II
publication.author: Cyrus Eaton
publication.notes: Eaton records a contemporary genealogy. Names, family groups, occupations and marriages are documented as published, but individual claimed kinships and ages are not independently proved by probate, civil certificates, or census here.

matthew.name: Capt. Matthew Beverage
matthew.origin_exact: b. in Topsham, or c. from there to Fox Islands
matthew.origin_caution: Wording is ambiguous: do not assert birth specifically in Topsham.
matthew.identity_caution: No proof that this Matthew is the 1785 minor or a son of James Beveridge and Jean White.

wives.name: Clarissa Cobb
wives.description: Second wife; Eaton writes 'of W.' without full expansion.

children.name: Mary Miles Beverage Tucker
children.information: Married Anselm Tucker; resident of Portland

children.name: James Madison Beverage
children.information: Married Mary J. Taylor of Hope; town officer in Thomaston

children.name: Thomas T. Beverage
children.information: Taught high school; nearly completed Bowdoin College; died 12 May 1864

children.name: Ezekiel G. D. Beverage
children.information: Married Martha Gilmore; lived East Union

children.name: Thomas Jefferson Beverage
children.information: Married Deborah M. Taylor of Hope 17 Nov 1842; joiner in Thomaston

children.name: George W. Beverage
children.information: Married Martha Frances Piper 11 Jan 1846; shoemaker in Thomaston

nathaniel.name: Nathaniel Beverage
nathaniel.reported_relation_to_matthew: Nephew of Capt. Matthew, according to Eaton; the exact degree has not been established.
nathaniel.spouse_reported_relation_to_matthew: Niece of Capt. Matthew, according to Eaton; her parental ancestry is unknown.

children.name: Henry T. Beverage
children.independent_record: FamilySearch-indexed 1898 Maine marriage to Ella Allen; 1900 US census indexed in her profile

candidate_parentage.status: Unverified derivative genealogy. May be same man Eaton calls born ~1804, but original parentage evidence not yet retrieved.
candidate_parentage.generational_issue: If Capt. Matthew were a brother of Capt. Thomas (1750), John White Beverage (Thomas's son) would be Matthew's nephew and Nathaniel his grandnephew, not simply nephew. This suggests an error or loose kinship term in one or both compiled sources; do not silently reconcile.

avoid_confusion.note: Nathaniel Winslow Beverage born 1776, son of Capt. Thomas and Mercy Kent, is clearly a different, older person from Nathaniel Beverage born c.1804.
